title: As Americans go direct with GLP-1 prescriptions, Walmart, Costco, Amazon will be big weight-loss winners
summary: The article discusses the trend of Americans opting for direct prescriptions of GLP-1 weight-loss drugs, which is expected to significantly benefit major retail pharmacy chains such as Walmart, Costco, and Amazon. This shift in consumer behavior towards direct purchasing is likely to reshape the landscape of weight-loss medication distribution. As these retailers capitalize on this trend, they are positioned to become key players in the weight-loss market.
